title: Add zod runtime validation for metadata type assertion
description: Replace unsafe 'as Record<string, unknown>' type assertions with zod schema validation for metadata fields
approach: Create a zod schema for metadata validation and use it to safely parse metadata from Prisma results. This provides runtime type safety while maintaining TypeScript compatibility. The schema allows unknown keys with unknown values, matching the current type assertion but with actual runtime validation.

tasks.title: Create metadata validation schema
tasks.description: Create a zod schema file for economic data validation, including a metadata schema that validates the structure at runtime.
implementation: Create new file: apps/api/src/graphql/schemas/economic-data.schema.ts
Import zod: `import { z } from 'zod';`
Define metadata schema: `export const metadataSchema = z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()).nullable();`
Export type: `export type Metadata = z.infer<typeof metadataSchema>;`
Add helper function: `export function parseMetadata(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null`
acceptance_criteria: Schema file created with zod import
Helper function parseMetadata that returns validated data or null
verification: File exists and compiles without errors
